evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Jules: 'This should take me about ten to fifteen minutes and then I'll get you an accurate estimate. Sounds good.' — framing present but rep does not wait for explicit yes before pivoting to name collection.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Tish Cruciani), date (October 19th), route (3130 North Harwood, Dallas to another condo, same building floors 12 to 19), size (~1900 sq ft) — all four gathered.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch: 1900 sq ft is at the threshold; rep does not offer virtual walkthrough, but this is same-building move with confirmed elevator reservation plan, so walkthrough offer may not be operationally necessary here. Treated as N/A.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (condo), floors (12 to 19, within building), rooms (3 bed but 2 beds + study), special considerations (artwork, sectional, boxes, possible storage), no washer/dryer/appliances. All major items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Jules: 'Do you need help packing the boxes?' — asked and declined by customer.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Jules: 'Usually when we move like a 1900 square foot condo, we usually see around ninety to a hundred boxes... Do you think you're gonna be within that range?' Customer responds 30–50 range.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Jules: '$1,836 to $2,448 in case it takes us eight hours' — provides range with time anchor and personalizes to 3-person crew for same-building move with elevator considerations.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Hourly rate ($102/mover), what's included (gas, truck, taxes, insurance, tools, wrapping, blankets). No mention of trip fee, overnight fee, or 2.5-hour minimum / 15-minute-increment commitment framing.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: No 'Does that feel fair?' or similar check asked; call moves directly to logistics confirmation.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No explicit close of the Two Promises section; rep does not confirm the two guarantees or ask if they put customer's concerns to rest.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: No genuine 'What's still concerning you?' or similar final check. Rep transitions directly to logistics and booking.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: No 'Anything else coming with you we haven't talked about?' — call does not ask.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' Rep says 'Thank you so much for choosing to move us again we'll see you on the nineteenth' — assumes the booking rather than asking.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial — date (October 19th) confirmed, phone (yes, customer's), crew size (3 movers), addresses (3130 North Harwood, Dallas to new condo floors 12→19). Missing: arrival window, storage address (if needed), crew notes about customer concerns.

top_strength: Jules gathered all core logistics details efficiently (property type, rooms, special items, box count) and provided a personalized, anchored price estimate for a same-building move with specific crew size and hourly breakdown.
coaching_note: Jules must ask Section 2's 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns?' before probing, deliver both Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) with full framing, and ask an explicit 'Would you like our help with your move?' in Section 7 rather than assuming the booking.
